difficulty_reason: Artin's core limit-preservation proof. Injectivity assembles the Remark-diagonal machinery: the equalizer E_{W,lambda} is a monomorphism into V_{lambda,/Z}, a closed immersion by the formal-spaces monomorphism lemma, a solution E_lambda exists by lemma-closed-immersion, and the limit factorization follows from the lfp characterization. Surjectivity descends an element (Z,u',hat x) etale-locally, reduces to affine W by algebraizing dilatations, and finishes with the algebra core (C_mu rings, theorem on formal functions, kernel/cokernel descent through powers of I, the Psi map with kernel annihilation) that Artin himself calls 'an algebraic analogue of a convergence proof in analysis'.
